reason: A monitoring plugin that watches command streams or growing files, filters and batches matching output, and wakes the agent through bounded background-job notices, with optional unattended daemon hosting.

summaries.zh: 监控命令输出或增长中的文件，按正则筛选并批量通知匹配内容，同时支持后台监听和无人值守运行。
summaries.en: Monitors command streams or growing files, filters and batches matching lines, and notifies the agent through background watches with optional unattended hosting.

capabilities: Watches command output and growing files for regex-matching lines
Spawns and monitors shell commands when configured
Runs background watches and an unattended daemon
Wakes the agent with bounded notices and exposes watch job lifecycle controls
